params.body:
Found while writing the README (#20). `src/layouts/Layout.astro`, `public/robots.txt` and `public/sitemap.xml` name `https://www.afrodidact.org` as the canonical address and the sitemap origin, while `deploy/nginx/sites-available/afrodidact.conf` sends `www.afrodidact.org` to the bare domain with a 301. Google was told the canonical is an address that redirects. Now `https://afrodidact.org` everywhere, which is also what `src/lib/site.ts` falls back to.

Three files, text only; CI runs the tests here.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: The canonical address is afrodidact.org, as nginx already says
